material.title: Vectors
material.summary: Introduces vectors as quantities with magnitude and direction, and shows how to measure and add them.
learning_objectives: Compute the length of a two-dimensional vector
Add two vectors component by component

concepts.name: Vector and magnitude
concepts.definition: A vector is a quantity with a magnitude and a direction; its magnitude is written ‖v‖.
principles: The magnitude of v = (a, b) is sqrt(a^2 + b^2)
misconceptions: A vector is just a number
source_evidence: A vector has a magnitude and a direction.

concepts.name: Vector addition
concepts.definition: Adding vectors means adding their components one by one.

scope_limitations: Does not cover three-dimensional vectors or the dot product
